svg.aria-label: Event-driven streaming over 24 frames: frame encoder, stage 1 and heads run every frame; stage 2 runs only on stage-1 boundaries; the main network steps and appends one KV-cache entry only on stage-2 boundaries.
svg.title: Event-driven streaming over 24 frames: frame encoder, stage 1 and heads run every frame; stage 2 runs only on stage-1 boundaries; the main network steps and appends one KV-cache entry only on stage-2 boundaries.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Streaming engine (vt/stream.py): one frame in, one action out

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: 24 consecutive frames, t = 244…267 at 10 Hz (illustrative boundary pattern). Filled cell = module runs at that frame; empty = skipped.
